state: Finding: button darker. Done when: darker.

done.instructions: Is the requested change visibly implemented in the AFTER image compared to BEFORE?

criteria.false: The AFTER screen does not show the requested change.
criteria.true: The AFTER screen clearly shows the requested change where the finding points.

status.instructions: How far is the finding implemented on the AFTER screen, judged against its Done when line?

criteria.done: Fully implemented: the AFTER screen meets the Done when line.
criteria.partial: Some of the requested change is visible, but not all of it.
criteria.not_done: The relevant area is unchanged or still has the reported problem.
criteria.cannot_tell: The relevant area is not visible, or the evidence is not enough.
